name: versioning-skill-is-followed
description: The Standard's versioning skill, pulled from the PeerLLM registry, states rules a model must apply rather than recite: a model change advances the first segment and resets the rest; a routine change advances the second; a fix advances the third. LLooMA is asked each case and must answer from the skill, not from semver habit.

prompts.prompt: Our current release is v1.2.3.4. This release changes a model. Under the versioning rules you were given, what is the next release version? Reply with the version only.
Our current release is v1.2.3.4. This release changes a service routine and nothing else. Under the versioning rules you were given, what is the next release version? Reply with the version only.
Our current release is v1.2.3.4. This release is a bug fix and nothing else. Under the versioning rules you were given, what is the next release version? Reply with the version only.
